HISTORY AND CITIZENSHIP — MOCK EXAM #15
====

GRADE: Grade 11
SUBJECT: HISTORY AND CITIZENSHIP
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours
TOTAL MARKS: 80
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which statement about Human Developments in Africa is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Explain Human Developments in Africa with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   B. Skip evidence when discussing Human Developments in Africa.
   C. Say Human Developments in Africa never happens in Kenya.
   D. Treat Human Developments in Africa as rumours only.

2. A map key (legend) is used to: (1 mark)
